notes: DP-1295: the shared CAN_SEE predicate carries LIGHT_OK — a dark room hides every body from a plain observer, mortal or immortal without holylight, while infravision and PRF_HOLYLIGHT restore sight and a lit room never gates. act()'s hide_invisible filter, PERS and room targeting all flow through the one predicate (R1/R5c/R5e/R5h).

A dark room drops hide_invisible acts for an observer who cannot see the actor, and the dark look renders "You hear someone or something moving around nearby." for a present peer; the lit vestibule delivers the same smile normally (R1/R5e).
A dark look renders the C darkness block and names a present peer only as "someone or something moving around nearby" (R1/R5e).
PRF_HOLYLIGHT, not level, reveals in darkness: the implementor's smile at the trainee resolves only while holylight is on, and the target lookup itself fails in the dark without it (R1/R5e).
AFF_INFRAVISION restores dark-room sight: after skillset and self-cast, the same smile resolves the trainee that the dark room hid before (R1/R3/R5e).
CAN_SEE_OBJ's LIGHT_OK arm: a dark room hides objects from a plain observer; infravision and holylight restore them (R1/R5c/R5e/R5h).
